If you saw failed imports: reply with ingest job ID, consent to re-run, and a 2-hour window. Our target window for replays is 2448 hours; for very large replays we'll coordinate a custom plan.

Compensation: affected tenants may be eligible for up to one day of tokenization usage credit (subject to verification).

Resources: status.redwood.ai (incident #2026-TKN) and tenant replay page: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/<tenant-id>/replays
